title: LaMDA: Language Models for Dialog Applications

bias_targets.methodology: Crowdworker evaluation of model responses to natural, sensitive, and adversarial-intent conversation prompts using a safety rubric that flags unjust impacts, stereotypes, and derogatory language directed at gender identity and expression or sex.

Crowdworker evaluation of model responses to natural, sensitive, and adversarial-intent conversation prompts using a safety rubric that flags unjust impacts, slurs, subhuman comparisons, and stereotypes directed at race, ethnicity, or caste.

Crowdworker evaluation of model responses to natural, sensitive, and adversarial-intent conversation prompts using a safety rubric that flags unjust impacts, slurs, and stereotypes directed at religious affiliations.

Crowdworker evaluation of model responses to natural, sensitive, and adversarial-intent conversation prompts using a safety rubric that flags insults, stereotypes, and unjust impacts regarding emotional, romantic, and/or sexual attraction.

Crowdworker evaluation of model responses to natural, sensitive, and adversarial-intent conversation prompts using a safety rubric that flags unjust impacts, inferiority claims, and stereotypes based on age.

Crowdworker evaluation of model responses to natural, sensitive, and adversarial-intent conversation prompts using a safety rubric that flags unjust impacts, stereotypes, and claims of physical or mental inferiority or deficiency.

Crowdworker evaluation of model responses to natural, sensitive, and adversarial-intent conversation prompts using a safety rubric that flags unjust impacts, xenophobia, and stereotypes based on nationality or immigration status.
